notes.title: New Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hello Engineers!

A big update to the Cubetory Demo just dropped. 

Notably, it includes : 
- New map generation : Smaller by default, but adjustable
- Metrics
- Power System improvements
- Balancing changes to recipes
- Sandbox mode
- Steam Cloud support
- Improved controls
- Custom map support

Please enjoy, and let me know in the discord if you run into any issues :)

notes.title: Demo Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello!👋 


Thanks to everyone who's been reporting bugs in the discord! The latest update to the demo includes the following bug fixes and improvements.


Updated machine graphics

Visual update to machine menus

Visual update to upgrade menu

Keep delete selected after doing a delete 

Undo now works with belt rotation

There's now a cursor indicator to help aligning deletes and copy pastes

Reworked the settings page to avoid keybindings being cutoff by a scroll-bar

Fixed an issue with being able to click through the save game page

Added the production panel to stampers

Fixed a bug where stamper windows would flicker in size

Cube rate of production numbers should be more stable now

Added splash rate to geyser mouse overs

Added a setting toggle to hide tutorial

Fixed loading stamper state, the outputs weren't persisted correctly.

notes.title: Small bugfix patch
notes.notes:
A new version of the demo was just released. Changes of note :

The simulation engine changes should lead to much better performance on older PCs

Fixed issues with borderless windows and multiple monitors

Tweaked the tutorial to help with learning the mechanics

Tweaked keybinding to allow re-binding left click

Development of the full game is going well, and should be able to start internal testing in the discord sometime in august.
